_about: Licensed source images chosen for website article pages, one per article ID, verified through the Wikimedia Commons API (license, artist, restrictions) on 2026-10-30. scripts/writing/fetch_article_images.py downloads originalUrl into images/articles/<W###-slug>.<ext>; npm run cloudinary:upload hosts them; scripts/writing/build_article_pages.py reads the credit, license, alt, and caption from here. Publisher photographs from the original articles are never used. Status none means no acceptable free image was found and the page shows a typographic cover.
